column2: By-Law on the Maintenance of Fish Stalls within the Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha Authoritative Area
This by-law is enacted to regulate, administer and control the operation of fish stalls within Kolonna Pradeshiya
This by-law is known as the By-Law of the sale of fish within the Kolonna pradeshiya sabha authoritative area.
No person shall maintain a fish sale place unless he has a valid license issued by the Chairman of any premises
within the area of the Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha (hereinafter referred to as the area).
Every person applying for a license under this by-law shall apply for a license under an application prepared in
accordance with the first schedule hereof.
